verdict.rationale: Zep documents per-user Context Graphs (memories ingested into the user-level knowledge graph via thread.add_messages), user-scoped deletion for RTBF, and ABAC policies that limit which context each agent or Memory MCP user can reach via UserGroups/API keys — all supporting tenant-scoped memory. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm agent- or application-level graph isolation beyond the user construct, nor is there independent/hands-on proof that cross-tenant leakage is actually prevented in practice. Missing for 10: explicit agent/application-scope isolation guarantees, and third-party validation of retrieval isolation.
